content: Tammanne Nam7u Hawaareti Kiitetidosona
Yesuusi tammanne nam7u hawaareta baako xeegidi, tuna ayyaanata kessana melanne harge ubbaa pathana mela wolqanne maata immis.
Xoossaa kawotethaaba markatanaadanne harganchota pathanaada kiittis.
I entako, “Xam7a gidin ogoro gidin kathi gidin miishe gidin laammidi ma7iya afila gidin oges gidi aykoka oykofite.
He katamaape hinte keyana gakanaw imathatethan hinte gelida keethan gam7ite.
Oonika hintena mokonna ixiko he katamaape keyishe entaw marka gidana mela hinte tohuwan de7iya baana pitidi keyite.”
Entika kiitetidaysada keyidi wongela odishenne dumma dumma gutatan harganchota pathishe aadhidosona.
Galila biitta haariya Herodiisi Yesuusi oothidaba ubbaa si7ida wode dagammis. Ayis giiko, issi issi asati Yohaanisi hayqope dendonna aggenna yaagosona.
Baggati, “Eeliyaasi qoncis” goosona; harati qassi, “Beni nabetape issoy hayqope dendis” yaagidi odetoosona.
Shin Herodiisi, “Taani Yohaanisa qoodhiya qanxisada wodhas. Yaatin, haysatho yaagetidi iyabaa odetey, I oonee?” yaagidi ba ayfen be7anaw koyees.
Ichashu Mukulu Asaa
Tammanne nam7u hawaareti guye simmi yidi, enti oothidaba ubbaa Yesuusas odidosona. I entana ekidi Beetesayda katamaape gaxa efis.
Shin daro asay Yesuusa gideysa eridi iya kaallidosona. I enta moki ekidi Xoossaa kawotethaaba tamaarsis; paxanaw koyeysataka pathis.
Sa7i omarsiya wode tammanne nam7u hawaareti iyako shiiqidi, “Nu de7ey mela biitta gidiya gisho asay dumma dumma gutatanne katamata bidi, kathinne aqiya bessi koyana mela asaa moyza” yaagidosona.
Shin I, “Entaw miyaba hinte immite” yaagis. Enti, “Nuus de7ey ichashu uythinne nam7u molo gidiya gisho, ha asaas gidiya kathi nuuni bidi shammonna ixiko gidenna” yaagidosona.
He bessan ichashu mukulu gidiya addeti de7oosona. Yesuusi ba tamaaretako, “Ishataman ishataman shaaki shaaki asaa utisite” yaagis.
Iya tamaareti, I kiitidaysada asaa utisidosona.
I ichashu uythaanne nam7u molota ekidi, salo xeellidi, Xoossaa galatidi, menthidi asaa ubbaa gathana mela ba tamaaretas immis.
Ubbay midi kallidosona. Entafe attida tiifey tammanne nam7u gayta kumethi gidis.
Phexroosa Markatetha
Yesuusi ba xalaala woossishin, iya tamaareti iyako yidosona. I, “Asay tana oona goonna?” gidi oychis.
Enti zaaridi “Issoti issoti, ‘Xammaqiya Yohaanisa, baggati Eeliyaasa, harati qassi, beni nabetape issoy hayqope dendis’ yaagosona” yaagidosona.
I zaaridi, “Yaatin hinte tana oona geetii?” yaagis. Phexroosi, “Neeni Xoossaafe kiitetida Kiristoosa” yaagidi zaaris.
Yesuusi haysa oodeska odopite gidi minthidi odis.
Qassika Yesuusi, “Asa Na7i daro metuwa ekana. Biitta cimata, kahine halaqatanne higge astamaareta kushen aadhidi imetana. Enti iya wodhana, shin I heedzantho gallas hayqope dendana” yaagis.
Yesuusi asaa ubbaako, “Tana kaallanaw koyey oonika de7iko bana kaddo, ba masqaliya gallas gallas tookidi tana kaallo.
Ba shempiw ashshanaw koya ubbay iyo dhaysees, ba shempiw ta gisho gidi dhaysiya oonika iyo ashshees.
Asi alame ubbaa haaridi, gidoshin, ba shempiw dhaysiyaba woyko qohiyaba gidiko iya ay maaddii?
Oonika tananinne ta qaalan yeellatiko, Asa Na7i ba bonchuwara hessadaka aawa bonchuwaranne Geeshsha kiitanchota bonchuwara yaa wode iyan yeellatana.
Ta hintew tuma odayis; haysan eqidaysata giddofe Xoossaa kawotethaa be7onnashin hayqonna asati de7oosona” yaagis.
Yesuusa Malay Laametis
Yesuusi he oda odin, hospun gallasape guye, Phexroosa, Yayqoobanne Yohaanisa baara ekidi woossanaw zuma bolla keyis.
I woosa bolla de7ishin iya ayfe karey laametis; afilayka booxidi, awa mela phoolis.
Nam7u asati, entika Museranne Eeliyaasara bonchon qoncidi,
Yerusalaamen poletanaw de7iyaba, hessika, I ha alamiyape shaaketanaba iyara odetoosona.
Phexroosanne iyara de7eyisata dhiskoy efin, enti dhiskofe barkiya wode iya bonchuwanne iyara eqida nam7u asata be7idosona.

Asati Yesuusape shaaketidi baana hanishin, Phexroosi Yesuusako, “Godaw, nu haysan gidiko nuus ay mela lo77o! Issino new, issino Muses, issino Eeliyaasas oothidi, heedzu shaqara shaqaroos” yaagis. Shin I ay gidaako erenna.
I yaagidi odetishin shaaray yidi entana kammis. Enti he shaara giddo gelishe babidosona.
Shaara giddofe, “Ta doorida na7ay haysa iya si7ite” giya qaali si7etis.
Qaali si7etidaape guye, Yesuusi barka de7ishe bentis. He wode enti be7idaba oodeska odonna, banta wozanan oykidi si77i gidoosona.
Tuna Ayyaani Oykida Na7a
Wontethe enti zuma bollafe wodhiya wode daro asay yidi iyara gahetidosona.
He wode asaa giddofe issi asi, “Astamaariyaw, ta issi na7aa yada be7arki.
Tuna ayyaanay qoponna oykidi waasisees; goponto yegisidi qakerethees, asatethaa qohidi un7ethidi yeddees.
Ne tamaareti kessana mela woossas, shin enti danda7ibookona” yaagidi woossis.
Yesuusi, “Ammanoy bayna geella yeletato, awude gakanaw ta hintera daane, hintena danda7anee? Ne na7aa bada haa ekaya” yaagis.
Na7aa ekidi yaa wode tuna ayyaanay sa7an holi yeggidi kokorsis. Shin Yesuusi tuna ayyaana hanqidi na7aape kessis. Na7aaka na7aa aawas immis.
Asa ubbay Xoossaa gita wolqan malaaletidosona. Enti I oothidaban malaaletishin, Yesuusi ba tamaaretako,
“Haysa ta hintew odeysa loythi si7ite; Asa Na7i morketa kushen aadhidi imetana” yaagis.
Shin I gidabay entafe geemmida gisho, akeekibokona. Hessa gisho, zaaridi oychanaw babidosona.
Ubbaafe Aadhey Oonee?
Yesuusa tamaareti, “Nu giddon gita gidanay oonee?” gidi palama oykidosona.
Yesuusi enta wozanaa qofaa eridi yooga na7aa ba matan essidi,
“Ha yooga na7aa ta sunthan mokiya oonika tana mokees, tana mokey tana kiittidaysa mokees, hinte ubbaafe guuxeysi, I gita gidana” yaagis.
Yohaanisi, “Godaw, issi asi ne sunthan tuna ayyaanata kessishin be7idi, I nuura gidonna gisho diggida” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Hintera eqetonnaysi, I hinte bagga. Hessa gisho, iya diggofite” yaagis.
Yesuusi Samaaren Ixetis
Yesuusi salo biya wodey matatida gisho, Yerusalaame baanaw qanxidi dendis.
Samaare biittan de7iya issi gutaa bidi, ubbaba iyaw giigisana mela ase yaa kiittis.
Shin I bey Yerusalaame gidiya gisho, enti iya moki ekibookona.
Yesuusa tamaareti Yayqoobaranne Yohaanisara hessa be7idi, “Godaw, salope tami wodhidi enta mo gaana mela ne koyay” yaagidosona.
Shin Yesuusi guye simmi enta hanqetidi, “Hinte garsan aybi ayyaani de7iyako hinte ereketa. Asa Na7i ase ashshanaw yisipe attishin, dhaysanaasa gidenna” yaagis.
Yaape dendidi hara guta bidosona.
Yesuusa Kaaloy Cigsiya Gate
Enti ogera bishin, issi asi, “Ne biya soo ubba ta kaallana” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Workanatas olli, salo kafotas keethi de7ees, shin Asa Na7i ba huuphe shempisiya bessi baawa” yaagis.
Hankuwako, “Neeni tana kaalla” yaagis. Shin uray, “Godaw, koyrottada ta aawa moogada yaana” yaagis.
Shin Yesuusi, “Hayqidaysati hayqidaysata moogana mela entaw aggaaga; neeni bada Xoossaa kawotethaa sabbaka” yaagis.
Qassi hara asi, “Godaw, ta nena kaallana, shin koyrottada ta soo asa sarothada yaana” yaagis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Koxe oykidi guye xeelliya oonika Xoossa kawotethas bessenna” yaagis.
